discovery_query: exact symbolic polynomial identity determinant exterior product

selected_contract.input: A square SymbolicMatrix over an explicitly ordered rational-function field QQ(t_1,...,t_n).
selected_contract.entries: Canonical reduced rational functions, represented by sparse rational numerator and denominator polynomials; denominator monic.
selected_contract.terms: Nonzero rational monomials in descending lexicographic exponent order.
selected_contract.rational: Decimal num and positive den strings, coprime; zero is 0/1.
selected_contract.larger_than_one_by_one: Polynomial entries; derived determinant expansion at most 256 terms, exponent 64, and 128-digit coefficient components.
selected_contract.output: SymbolicDeterminantResult with determinant RationalFunction and method SYMPY_BAREISS.

scope: The universal two-by-two wedge perturbation identity. Substitution of t-adic weights is checked separately by verify.py. No analytic existence claim is delegated to this operation.
